name: user-redaction-vectors
about: Shared vectors for the user-name step of report redaction (andronix-distros internal/app/problem.go and the app's StandaloneReport.kt). The input is the text as it reaches the user-name step: tokens, emails and the home path are already replaced. Each case: users = the distro user names, input, expected. Lines end in \n only.

cases.name: kali: distro words stay
cases.input:
Setting up kali-linux-core (2026.3) ...
andronix install kali --de xfce
Get:1 http://http.kali.org/kali kali-rolling InRelease
cases.expected:
Setting up kali-linux-core (2026.3) ...
andronix install kali --de xfce
Get:1 http://http.kali.org/kali kali-rolling InRelease

cases.name: kali: home path
cases.input: cp: cannot create regular file '/home/kali/.bashrc': Permission denied
cases.expected: cp: cannot create regular file '/home/<user>/.bashrc': Permission denied

cases.name: kali: su and sudo -u
cases.input:
su - kali -c startxfce4
sudo -u kali dbus-launch xfce4-session

cases.name: kali: account command, name last on the line
debian: package names and release stay
cases.input:
E: Unable to locate package debian-archive-keyring
Debian GNU/Linux 13 (trixie)
debian@localhost:~$ ls /home/debian/Desktop
cases.expected:
E: Unable to locate package debian-archive-keyring
Debian GNU/Linux 13 (trixie)
<user>@localhost:~$ ls /home/<user>/Desktop

cases.name: ubuntu: prompt only
cases.input:
ubuntu@localhost:~$ sudo apt install ubuntu-desktop-minimal
E: ubuntu-desktop-minimal has no installation candidate
cases.expected:
<user>@localhost:~$ sudo apt install ubuntu-desktop-minimal
E: ubuntu-desktop-minimal has no installation candidate

cases.name: arch: architecture words stay
cases.input:
error: package not available for arch aarch64
user arch has no password
/home/arch/.xinitrc missing
cases.expected:
error: package not available for arch aarch64
user <user> has no password
/home/<user>/.xinitrc missing

cases.name: xfce: desktop words stay
cases.input:
Installing XFCE desktop: xfce4 xfce4-goodies
desktop=xfce
/home/xfce/.config/xfce4/xfconf missing
cases.expected:
Installing XFCE desktop: xfce4 xfce4-goodies
desktop=xfce
/home/<user>/.config/xfce4/xfconf missing

cases.name: user: the word user stays; only real user contexts change
cases.input:
user is not in the sudoers file. This incident will be reported.
user@localhost:~$ id
uid=1000(user) gid=1000(user)
cases.expected:
user is not in the sudoers file. This incident will be reported.
<user>@localhost:~$ id
uid=1000(<user>) gid=1000(<user>)

cases.name: normal name: every whole-word match (today's rule)
cases.input:
priya@localhost:~$ ls /home/priya
echo priya done; priya-laptop

cases.name: normal name inside a longer word stays
two users: longest first, each by its own rule
root and one-letter names are never scrubbed
a name that is the placeholder word: no double scrub
